whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Cakes & Bakes,

I noticed your bakery has an impressive 4.3★ rating with over 700 reviews on Dak Bungalow Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering page for birthday and custom cakes.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, anniversary/birthday menu showcase, aur instant delivery inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cakesandbakes

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Cakes & Bakes Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke bakery (Cakes & Bakes on Dak Bungalow Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and mobile-first menu showcase for Patna customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cake varieties aur prices setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
